svg.title: Riju surrenders the anomaly notebook as the promised direct appointment is suspended.
svg.desc: Riju passes the private notebook into the public evidence area and admits that the promised job influenced his judgement. Ila receives it while Vale records that the direct appointment is suspended.
svg.text: Page 54, panel 4 · Side medium shot as the notebook changes hands

text.tspan: Riju names the promised post as an influence and
surrenders both the ledger and the benefit.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
